pins.name: B+
pins.notes: To the cell +. One 3.7 V Li-ion / LiPo cell only

pins.name: B-
pins.notes: To the cell -. Not the same as GND: protection sits in between

pins.name: OUT+
pins.notes: 3.0 to 4.2 V to the load. Too low for VIN: use an LDO or a boost to 5 V

pins.name: OUT-
pins.notes: Load ground: to the ESP32 GND

sources.title: NanJing Top Power TP4056 datasheet
sources.section: Charge to 4.2 V; current set by RPROG (1.2 kΩ = 1 A)
